The '''Milk Pail''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to gather [[milk]] from [[cow]]s and [[goat]]s. It must be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|1000}}.

Each use of the Milk Pail to milk a cow or goat consumes 4 points of [[energy]], and increases the player's [[Farming]] experience by 5 points.

Using the Milk Pail on an animal other than a cow or goat will produce the message "[Animal name] doesn't produce milk."

Once the player has reached [[Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Level 10]], an [[Auto-Grabber]] can be purchased from Marnie's Ranch for {{Price|25000}}, which will automatically milk all cows and goats from the [[barn]] in which it is placed.
